event: first read-only gate-aggregator launch was rejected before process start because the PowerShell argument vector exceeded the Windows command-line length limit
tool_error: ResourceUnavailable: python.exe failed to run; The filename or extension is too long.
cause: The source-snapshot paths were expanded into one long argv list.
resolution: A small audit-owned capture wrapper now constructs the source snapshot list in Python and invokes only the read-only aggregator. No solver/provider was rerun.
